page.content:
Hustle, Loyalty, Respect — the 2000s face of the company.

How John Cena connects

  • Work: Monday Night Raw — John Cena was the long-running face of Monday Night Raw.
  • Item: Undisputed WWE Championship — John Cena's sixteen world-title reigns include later Undisputed-era returns.

What is John Cena?

John Cena carried WWE's PG-era flagship as a multi-time champion, Super Cena workhorse, and later part-time attraction whose sixteen world-title count became a running story.

Key threads lead to Monday Night Raw and Undisputed WWE Championship.
